**A SUR VEY OF TWISTED ALEXANDER POLYNOMIALS**

*STEF AN FRIEDL AND STEF ANO VIDUSSI*

42 pp, 40 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a short introduction to the theory of twisted Alexand er polynomials of a 3–manifold associated to a representation of its fundam ental group. We summarize their formal properties and we explain their relationship t o twisted Reidemeister torsion. We then give a survey of the many applications of twisted inva riants to the study of topological problems. We conclude with a short summary of th e theory of higher order Alexander polynomials.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2.1 Twisted Reidemeister torsion; 2 Definition and basic properties; 2.2 Computation of twisted Reidemeister torsio; 2.4 Twisted Alexander invariants; 2.5 Computation of twisted Alexander polynomia; 3 Basic properties of twisted invariants; 3.1 Relationship between twisted invariants; 3.2 Twisted invariants for conjugate represent; 3.3 Change of variables; 3.4 Duality for twisted invariants; 3.6 Twisted invariants of knots and links; 4 Distinguishing knots and links; 5 Twisted Alexander polynomials and concordanc; 5.1 Twisted Alexander polynomials of zero–surg; 5.2 Twisted Alexander polynomials and knot con; 5.3 Ribbon knots and doubly slice knots; 5.4 Twisted invariants and slice links
